system.description:
You have acquired "Servant Summon: Unicorn" and "Servant Summon: Alraune" with their SR increased by +1 (may exceed maximum SR), and their guaranteed effect becomes "Range: 2Sq". A short staff crafted from a branch of the Millennium Tree, which blooms once every millennium and brings hope to Celdecia. By the great natural power that maintains the balance of the world, it enhances the healing summoned creatures called by the user.

Seed of the Millennial King Tree [Core Material] (560G) + Cypress Wand (810G) + [Magic Catalyst 18] (310G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (1070G)
